# Woodstock Heating & Cooling

> Woodstock Heating & Cooling is a local HVAC company serving Woodstock, Oxford County, Ontario, offering furnace repair, AC repair, ductless mini-split installation, heat pump repair and installation, fireplace installation, thermostat repair, and duct cleaning to homeowners across the region.

Phone: (519) 539-9000  |  Email: contact@woodstockheatingcooling.ca  |  Website: https://woodstockheatingcooling.ca

Service areas: Woodstock, Ingersoll, Tillsonburg, Norwich, Thamesford, Embro
